# 8. engine
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Engine(object):
    def __init__(self, watchlist):
        self.entries = watchlist
        self.lex = Lexicon()
        self._parses = {}
        self._build_lexicon()
        self._build_index()

    # -- token resolution ---------------------------------------------------
    def classes(self, bare, sc="latin"):
        """Candidate classes for one core token."""
        if sc != "latin":
            direct = self.lex.surface.get(bare)
            if direct is not None:
                return [(self.lex.find(direct), 0.0)]
            lat = to_latin(bare)
            out = self.lex.resolve(lat)
            return out or [("?" + bare, 0.0)]
        out = self.lex.resolve(bare)
        if not out or out[0][1] > 0.0:
            alt = strip_article_attached(bare)
            if alt:
                o2 = self.lex.resolve(alt)
                if o2 and (not out or o2[0][1] < out[0][1]):
                    out = o2
        if not out:
            return [("?" + "".join(self.lex.skel(bare)), 0.0)]
        return out

    # -- lexicon ------------------------------------------------------------
    def parse(self, name):
        p = self._parses.get(name)
        if p is None:
            p = NameParse(name)
            self._parses[name] = p
        return p

    def _build_lexicon(self):
        lex = self.lex
        persons = [e for e in self.entries
                   if (e.get("type") or "").lower() == "individual"]
        for e in persons:
            pp = self.parse(e.get("primary_name") or "")
            for bare, sc in pp.core:
                if sc == "latin":
                    lex.add_surface(bare, bare)
            for bare, sc in pp.nasab:
                if sc == "latin":
                    lex.add_surface(bare, bare)
        # script names aligned with a latin primary
        for e in persons:
            sn = e.get("script_name")
            pn = e.get("primary_name") or ""
            if not sn or script_of(pn) != "latin":
                continue
            pp, sp = self.parse(pn), self.parse(sn)
            if len(sp.core) == len(pp.core) and len(sp.nasab) == len(pp.nasab):
                for (sb, ssc), (pb, psc) in zip(sp.core, pp.core):
                    if ssc != "latin" and psc == "latin":
                        lex.add_surface(sb, pb)
                for (sb, ssc), (pb, psc) in zip(sp.nasab, pp.nasab):
                    if ssc != "latin" and psc == "latin":
                        lex.add_surface(sb, pb)
        # strong aliases aligned with the primary
        for e in persons:
            pn = e.get("primary_name") or ""
            pp = self.parse(pn)
            for al in e.get("aliases") or []:
                if al.get("strength") != "strong":
                    continue
                ap = self.parse(al.get("name") or "")
                if len(ap.core) != len(pp.core):
                    continue
                for (ab, asc), (pb, psc) in zip(ap.core, pp.core):
                    if asc == "latin" and psc == "latin":
                        lex.add_surface(ab, pb)
                    elif asc == "latin" and psc != "latin":
                        cls = lex.surface.get(pb)
                        if cls:
                            lex.add_surface(ab, cls)
                for (ab, asc), (pb, psc) in zip(ap.nasab, pp.nasab):
                    if asc == "latin" and psc == "latin":
                        lex.add_surface(ab, pb)
        # english nicknames
        for full, nicks in NICKNAMES.items():
            cls = lex.surface.get(full)
            if cls is None:
                for nk in nicks:
                    if nk in lex.surface:
                        cls = lex.surface[nk]
                        break
            if cls is None:
                continue
            lex.add_surface(full, cls)
            for nk in nicks:
                lex.add_surface(nk, cls)
        # slavic feminine surnames
        for surf in list(lex.surface.keys()):
            if script_of(surf) != "latin":
                continue
            m = re.match(r"^(.*(?:ov|ev|in|yn))a$", surf)
            if m and m.group(1) in lex.surface:
                lex.union(lex.surface[surf], lex.surface[m.group(1)])
            elif surf.endswith("skaya") and surf[:-5] + "sky" in lex.surface:
                lex.union(lex.surface[surf], lex.surface[surf[:-5] + "sky"])
            elif surf.endswith("aya") and surf[:-3] + "y" in lex.surface:
                lex.union(lex.surface[surf], lex.surface[surf[:-3] + "y"])
        lex.finalize()

    # -- index --------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_index(self):
        self.by_id = defaultdict(list)
        self.by_class = defaultdict(list)
        self.by_org = defaultdict(list)
        self.by_orgvar = defaultdict(list)
        self.by_weak = defaultdict(list)
        for e in self.entries:
            for ident in e.get("ids") or []:
                key = ((ident.get("type") or "").strip().lower(),
                       re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "",
                              (ident.get("number") or "").lower()))
                self.by_id[key].append(e["uid"])
            for al in e.get("aliases") or []:
                if al.get("strength") == "weak":
                    self.by_weak[weak_key(al.get("name") or "")].append(e)
            typ = (e.get("type") or "").lower()
            if typ == "individual":
                names = self._person_names(e)
                e["_names"] = names
                seen = set()
                for nm in names:
                    for c in nm["given_cls"] + nm["family_cls"]:
                        if (c, id(nm)) in seen:
                            continue
                        seen.add((c, id(nm)))
                        self.by_class[c].append(e)
            else:
                keys, vkeys = set(), set()
                for nm in self._org_names(e):
                    keys.add(org_key(nm))
                    vkeys |= org_variant_keys(nm)
                e["_orgkeys"] = keys
                for k in keys:
                    self.by_org[k].append(e)
                for k in vkeys:
                    self.by_orgvar[k].append(e)

    def _org_names(self, e):
        out = [e.get("primary_name") or ""]
        for al in e.get("aliases") or []:
            if al.get("strength") == "strong":
                out.append(al.get("name") or "")
        return [n for n in out if n.strip()]

    def _person_names(self, e):
        out = []
        seen = set()
        cand = [e.get("primary_name") or ""]
        sn = e.get("script_name")
        if sn and sn != e.get("primary_name"):
            cand.append(sn)
        for al in e.get("aliases") or []:
            if al.get("strength") == "strong":
                cand.append(al.get("name") or "")
        for nm in cand:
            if not nm.strip():
                continue
            p = self.parse(nm)
            if not p.core:
                continue
            keep = [c for c in p.core
                    if not (len(p.core) > 2 and looks_patronymic(c[0], c[1]))]
            if len(keep) < 2:
                keep = list(p.core)
            gcls = [c for c, _ in self.classes(*keep[0])]
            fcls = [c for c, _ in self.classes(*keep[-1])]
            single = len(keep) == 1
            key = (tuple(sorted(gcls)), tuple(sorted(fcls)), single)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            out.append({"raw": nm, "given_cls": gcls, "family_cls": fcls,
                        "single": single})
        return out

    # -- screening ----------------------------------------------------------
    def screen(self, cust):
        typ = (cust.get("type") or "").strip().lower()
        idt = (cust.get("id_type") or "").strip().lower()
        idn = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", (cust.get("id_number") or "").lower())
        if idt and idn:
            uids = self.by_id.get((idt, idn))
            if uids:
                return sorted(uids)[0]
        name = cust.get("full_name") or ""
        dob = cust.get("dob") or ""
        if typ in ("entity", "vessel"):
            cands = self.match_org(name)
        elif typ == "individual":
            cands = self.match_person(name, dob)
        else:
            cands = self.match_org(name) or self.match_person(name, dob)
        cands = cands + self.match_weak(name, dob)
        if not cands:
            return None
        cands.sort(key=lambda c: (-c[0], c[1]))
        return cands[0][1]

    def match_weak(self, name, dob):
        out = []
        nd = norm_date(dob)
        if len(nd) != 10:
            return out
        for e in self.by_weak.get(weak_key(name), ()):
            if norm_date(e.get("dob") or "") == nd:
                out.append((2, e["uid"]))
        return out

    def match_org(self, name):
        out = []
        seen = set()
        for e in self.by_org.get(org_key(name), ()):
            if e["uid"] not in seen:
                seen.add(e["uid"])
                out.append((1, e["uid"]))
        if out:
            return out
        for k in org_variant_keys(name):
            for e in self.by_orgvar.get(k, ()):
                if e["uid"] not in seen:
                    seen.add(e["uid"])
                    out.append((1, e["uid"]))
        return out

    def match_person(self, name, dob):
        p = self.parse(name)
        if not p.core:
            return []
        cls = [self.classes(b, sc) for b, sc in p.core]
        patro = [looks_patronymic(b, sc) for b, sc in p.core]
        cand = {}
        for lst in cls:
            for c, _ in lst:
                for e in self.by_class.get(c, ()):
                    cand[e["uid"]] = e
        out = []
        for uid, e in cand.items():
            st = dob_compare(dob, e.get("dob") or "")
            if st == "conflict":
                continue
            for nm in e["_names"]:
                if self.name_match(p, cls, patro, nm):
                    out.append((2 if st == "agree" else 1, uid))
                    break
        return out

    def name_match(self, p, cls, patro, nm):
        n = len(cls)
        if nm["single"]:
            if n != 1 or not nm["family_cls"]:
                return False
            fset = set(nm["family_cls"])
            return bool(set(c for c, _ in cls[0]) & fset)
        if n < 2:
            return False
        gset, fset = set(nm["given_cls"]), set(nm["family_cls"])
        if not gset or not fset:
            return False
        idx = [i for i in range(n) if not (patro[i] and i > 0)]
        if len(idx) < 2:
            idx = list(range(n))
        first, last = idx[0], idx[-1]
        cf = set(c for c, _ in cls[first])
        cl = set(c for c, _ in cls[last])
        if (cf & gset) and (cl & fset):
            return True
        if (cl & gset) and (cf & fset):
            return True
        if p.strands:
            ef = cf | self._strand_classes(p, p.core[first])
            el = cl | self._strand_classes(p, p.core[last])
            if (ef & gset) and (el & fset):
                return True
            if (el & gset) and (ef & fset):
                return True
        return False

    def _strand_classes(self, p, core_tok):
        bare, sc = core_tok
        if sc != "latin":
            return set()
        out = set()
        for pref in ("".join(p.strands), p.strands[-1]):
            if not pref:
                continue
            for c, _ in self.classes(pref + bare):
                out.add(c)
        return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. driver
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def run(watchlist_path, customers_path, out_path):
    with open(watchlist_path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        watchlist = json.load(fh)
    eng = Engine(watchlist)
    rows = []
    with open(customers_path, encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as fh:
        for cust in csv.DictReader(fh):
            uid = eng.screen(cust)
            rows.append((cust.get("customer_id", ""),
                         "MATCH" if uid else "NO_MATCH", uid or ""))
    with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
        wr = csv.writer(fh)
        wr.writerow(["customer_id", "decision", "matched_uid"])
        wr.writerows(rows)
    return rows


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="sanctions screening")
    ap.add_argument("--watchlist", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--customers", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    run(args.watchlist, args.customers, args.out)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Sanctions screening engine.

Matches customer records against a watchlist under the rules in
screening_policy.md: transliteration equivalence (Arabic / Persian /
Cyrillic romanizations, Chinese company romanizations), name order,
particles, patronymics, nicknames, aliases, company suffixes, vessel
prefixes, identifiers and dates of birth.

Standard library only.  Usage:

    python3 screen.py --watchlist watchlist.json --customers customers.csv \
                      --out decisions.csv
"""

import argparse
import csv
import json
import re
import sys
import unicodedata
from collections import defaultdict

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# character level normalisation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# graphemes that must be expanded *before* combining marks are stripped,
# because stripping the mark would destroy the sound (Turkish s-cedilla is
# "sh", Czech c-caron is "ch", ...).
PRE_MAP = {
    "ß": "ss",                                     # ss
    "æ": "ae", "œ": "oe", "ø": "o", "å": "a",
    "ü": "ue", "ö": "oe", "ä": "ae",     # German umlauts
    "ı": "i", "ş": "sh", "ç": "ch",      # Turkish
    "ğ": "gh",
    "š": "sh", "ž": "zh", "č": "ch",     # Czech / scientific
    "ć": "ch", "ś": "sh", "ź": "zh", "ż": "zh",
    "ř": "rzh", "ł": "l", "ń": "n", "ę": "e",
    "ą": "a", "ñ": "n", "ð": "d", "þ": "th",
    "đ": "d", "ć": "ch",
}

_COMBINING = dict.fromkeys(
    c for c in range(0x300, 0x370)
)


def deaccent(s):
    """Lower-case, expand special graphemes, drop combining marks."""
    s = s.lower()
    out = []
    for ch in s:
        out.append(PRE_MAP.get(ch, ch))
    s = "".join(out)
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFD", s)
    s = "".join(c for c in s if not unicodedata.combining(c))
    return s


ARABIC_RE = re.compile(r"[؀-ۿݐ-ݿ]")
CYRILLIC_RE = re.compile(r"[Ѐ-ӿ]")
CJK_RE = re.compile(r"[㐀-鿿]")


def script_of(s):
    if ARABIC_RE.search(s):
        return "arab"
    if CYRILLIC_RE.search(s):
        return "cyr"
    if CJK_RE.search(s):
        return "cjk"
    return "latin"


# --- Arabic / Persian -------------------------------------------------------

AR_NORM = {
    "ي": "ی", "ى": "ی", "ئ": "ی",  # ya forms
    "ك": "ک",                                          # kaf
    "ة": "ه",                                          # ta marbuta
    "أ": "ا", "إ": "ا", "آ": "ا",  # alif+hamza
    "ؤ": "و",
    "ٱ": "ا",
}

AR_TRANSLIT = {
    "ا": "a", "ب": "b", "ت": "t", "ث": "th",
    "ج": "j", "ح": "h", "خ": "kh", "د": "d",
    "ذ": "dh", "ر": "r", "ز": "z", "س": "s",
    "ش": "sh", "ص": "s", "ض": "d", "ط": "t",
    "ظ": "z", "ع": "", "غ": "gh", "ف": "f",
    "ق": "q", "ک": "k", "ل": "l", "م": "m",
    "ن": "n", "ه": "h", "و": "u", "ی": "i",

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# phonetic skeleton
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#
# A skeleton is a tuple of symbols.  Consonants keep (coarse) identity,
# vowels collapse into three classes.  Spelling conventions that differ only
# in orthography (sch/sh/sz/sj/s-caron, tsch/tch/cz/ch, w/v, ff/v, kh/ch/h,
# ou/u, y/i, doubled letters, silent final -e) collapse to the same symbol.

VOWELS = set("aeiouy")

# multi-character graphemes, longest first
DIGRAPHS = [
    ("shch", "S C"), ("stsch", "S C"), ("tsch", "C"), ("dsch", "J"),
    ("sch", "S"), ("tch", "C"), ("tsh", "C"), ("dzh", "J"), ("zsh", "Z"),
    ("sh", "S"), ("cz", "C"), ("sz", "S"), ("sj", "S"), ("tj", "C"),
    ("dj", "J"), ("zh", "Z"), ("ts", "T"), ("tz", "T"), ("ch", "X"),
    ("kh", "h"), ("gh", "g"), ("ph", "f"), ("th", "t"), ("ck", "k"),
    ("qu", "k v"), ("qv", "k v"), ("x", "k s"), ("q", "k"), ("w", "v"),
    ("nj", "n y"), ("rzh", "r"),
]

VOWEL_CLASS = {"a": "A", "e": "E", "i": "E", "o": "O", "u": "O", "y": "E"}


def _vowel_cluster_class(cluster):
    """Class of a run of vowel letters: decided by the first vowel."""
    return VOWEL_CLASS.get(cluster[0], "E")


def skeleton(tok):
    """Return a tuple of phonetic symbols for a latin token."""
    s = deaccent(tok)
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z]", "", s)
    if not s:
        return ()
    # silent final -e  (Bakre -> Bakr, Qaseeme -> Qaseem)
    if len(s) > 3 and s.endswith("e") and s[-2] not in VOWELS:
        s = s[:-1]
    # final -h after a vowel is silent (Mustafah, Hudah)
    if len(s) > 3 and s.endswith("h") and s[-2] in VOWELS and s[-3:] != "iah":
        s = s[:-1]
    out = []
    i = 0
    n = len(s)
    while i < n:
        ch = s[i]
        if ch in VOWELS:
            if ch == "y" and (i == 0 or s[i - 1] not in VOWELS) and \
                    i + 1 < n and s[i + 1] in VOWELS:
                out.append("y")          # consonantal y
                i += 1
                continue
            if ch == "i" and i == 0 and i + 1 < n and s[i + 1] in "aeou":
                out.append("y")          # Iachin = Yashin
                i += 1
                continue
            j = i
            while j < n and s[j] in VOWELS:
                j += 1
            # a trailing y/i before another vowel is consonantal: Sayed
            if j - i > 1 and s[j - 1] in "yi" and j < n and s[j] in VOWELS:
                cluster = s[i:j - 1]
                out.append(_vowel_cluster_class(cluster))
                out.append("y")
                i = j
                continue
            out.append(_vowel_cluster_class(s[i:j]))
            i = j
            continue
        matched = False
        for gr, rep in DIGRAPHS:
            if s.startswith(gr, i):
                out.extend(rep.split())
                i += len(gr)
                matched = True
                break
        if matched:
            continue
        if ch == "j":
            out.append("J")
        elif ch == "c":
            out.append("c")              # ambiguous bare c
        elif ch == "z":
            out.append("z")
        else:
            out.append(ch)
        i += 1
    # collapse doubles
    res = []
    for sym in out:
        if res and res[-1] == sym:
            continue
        res.append(sym)
    return tuple(res)


# --- weighted distance ------------------------------------------------------

def _mk_costs():
    c = {}

    def put(a, b, v):
        c[(a, b)] = v
        c[(b, a)] = v

    # vowels
    put("A", "E", 0.30)
    put("A", "O", 0.40)
    put("E", "O", 0.40)
    # sibilants / affricates
    put("s", "S", 0.35)
    put("s", "z", 0.30)
    put("s", "T", 0.35)
    put("z", "T", 0.35)
    put("z", "Z", 0.30)
    put("S", "Z", 0.35)
    put("S", "C", 0.30)
    put("C", "T", 0.30)
    put("C", "J", 0.30)
    put("J", "Z", 0.20)
    put("J", "y", 0.25)
    put("J", "g", 0.35)
    put("J", "h", 0.45)
    put("S", "X", 0.10)
    put("C", "X", 0.10)
    put("h", "X", 0.25)
    put("k", "X", 0.25)
    put("J", "X", 0.30)
    put("T", "X", 0.30)
    put("s", "X", 0.30)
    # ambiguous bare c: k / s / ts / ch / sh / j
    for other, v in (("k", 0.12), ("s", 0.12), ("T", 0.15), ("C", 0.12),
                     ("S", 0.20), ("J", 0.18), ("X", 0.10), ("z", 0.25),
                     ("g", 0.35)):
        put("c", other, v)
    # stops / fricatives
    put("t", "d", 0.30)
    put("p", "b", 0.35)
    put("p", "f", 0.35)
    put("b", "v", 0.40)
    put("f", "v", 0.25)
    put("k", "g", 0.35)
    put("k", "h", 0.30)
    put("g", "h", 0.35)
    put("t", "T", 0.40)
    put("d", "T", 0.50)
    put("t", "s", 0.55)
    # nasals / liquids / glides
    put("m", "n", 0.55)
    put("l", "r", 0.60)
    put("y", "E", 0.25)
    put("y", "v", 0.55)
    put("n", "l", 0.70)
    put("v", "g", 0.60)
    return c


SUB_COST = _mk_costs()
INDEL = {"A": 0.40, "E": 0.40, "O": 0.40, "h": 0.25, "y": 0.35,
         "v": 0.55, "n": 0.60, "r": 0.60, "l": 0.60}
DEFAULT_INDEL = 0.85
DEFAULT_SUB = 1.0


def sub_cost(a, b):
    if a == b:
        return 0.0
    return SUB_COST.get((a, b), DEFAULT_SUB)


def indel_cost(a):
    return INDEL.get(a, DEFAULT_INDEL)


def pdist(a, b, cutoff=1.2):
    """Weighted edit distance between skeletons, bounded by *cutoff*."""
    la, lb = len(a), len(b)
    if la == 0 or lb == 0:
        return sum(indel_cost(x) for x in (a or b))
    prev = [0.0] * (lb + 1)
    for j in range(1, lb + 1):
        prev[j] = prev[j - 1] + indel_cost(b[j - 1])
    for i in range(1, la + 1):
        cur = [prev[0] + indel_cost(a[i - 1])] + [0.0] * lb
        ai = a[i - 1]
        best = cur[0]
        for j in range(1, lb + 1):
            bj = b[j - 1]
            v = prev[j - 1] + (0.0 if ai == bj else sub_cost(ai, bj))
            d = prev[j] + indel_cost(ai)
            if d < v:
                v = d
            d = cur[j - 1] + indel_cost(bj)
            if d < v:
                v = d
            # transposition (Faris / Farsi stays expensive, but handles
            # genuine metathesis cheaply only when symbols are identical)
            if i > 1 and j > 1 and ai == b[j - 2] and a[i - 2] == bj:
                d = prevprev[j - 2] + 0.55
                if d < v:
                    v = d
            cur[j] = v
            if v < best:
                best = v
        if best > cutoff:
            return best
        prevprev = prev
        prev = cur
    return prev[lb]

def strip_article(tok):
    """Remove a leading arabic article, hyphenated, spaced or assimilated."""
    t = tok
    m = re.match(r"^(a|e|u|i)([lnrszdt])?[-'’]", t)
    if m:
        return t[m.end():]
    return t


def is_initial(tok):
    t = tok.strip(".")
    return len(t) == 1 and t.isalpha()


ROMAN_RE = re.compile(r"^(i{1,3}|iv|v|vi{1,3}|ix|x)$")


def tokenize(name):
    """Split a name into (tokens, comma_position)."""
    s = name.strip()
    s = s.replace("’", "'").replace("‘", "'")
    comma = None
    parts = re.split(r"\s*,\s*", s)
    if len(parts) > 1:
        head = re.split(r"[\s]+", parts[0].strip())
        rest = re.split(r"[\s]+", " ".join(parts[1:]).strip())
        toks = [t for t in head + rest if t]
        comma = len([t for t in head if t])
    else:
        toks = [t for t in re.split(r"[\s]+", s) if t]
    return toks, comma

        self.nasab = []

PATRONYM_RE = re.compile(
    r"(ovich|evich|owitsch|ovitch|evitch|owich|ewich|ovic|evic|itch|ich|"
    r"ovna|evna|owna|ewna|itschna|ichna|ovitsch|evitsch|ovyc|evyc)$")


def looks_patronymic(lat):
    if len(lat) < 6:
        return False
    return bool(PATRONYM_RE.search(lat))


def merge_particles(tokens):
    """Join western particles and arabic articles onto the following token.

    Returns a list of (surface, kind) where kind is 'core' or 'strand'.
    """
    out = []
    pend = []
    i = 0
    n = len(tokens)
    while i < n:
        t = tokens[i]
        lat = to_latin(t)
        bare = re.sub(r"[^a-z']", "", lat)
        if not bare:
            i += 1
            continue
        if bare in WEST_PARTICLES or bare in ARTICLES:
            if i + 1 < n:
                nxt = re.sub(r"[^a-z']", "", to_latin(tokens[i + 1]))
                if nxt and nxt not in NASAB:
                    pend.append(bare)
                    i += 1
                    continue
            out.append((bare, "strand"))
            i += 1
            continue
        if pend:
            out.append(("".join(pend) + bare, "core", bare))
            pend = []
        else:
            out.append((bare, "core", bare))
        i += 1
    for p in pend:
        out.append((p, "strand"))
    return out

    "refugio": ["cuco"],
}


def nickname_pairs():
    out = []
    for full, nicks in NICKNAMES.items():
        for n in nicks:
            out.append((n, full))
    return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# lexicon: surface form -> canonical class
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Lexicon(object):
    def __init__(self):
        self.parent = {}
        self.surface = {}        # surface string -> class root
        self.by_skel = defaultdict(set)
        self.entries = []        # (surface, skeleton, class)
        self._cache = {}
        self._skel_cache = {}

    # --- union find ---
    def find(self, x):
        p = self.parent
        while p.get(x, x) != x:
            p[x] = p.get(p[x], p[x])
            x = p[x]
        return x

    def union(self, a, b):
        ra, rb = self.find(a), self.find(b)
        if ra == rb:
            return ra
        if rb < ra:
            ra, rb = rb, ra
        self.parent[rb] = ra
        self.parent.setdefault(ra, ra)
        return ra

    def add_class(self, name):
        self.parent.setdefault(name, name)
        return self.find(name)

    def add_surface(self, surf, cls):
        if not surf:
            return
        self.add_class(cls)
        prev = self.surface.get(surf)
        if prev is not None:
            self.union(prev, cls)
        else:
            self.surface[surf] = cls

    def skel(self, s):
        v = self._skel_cache.get(s)
        if v is None:
            v = skeleton(s)
            self._skel_cache[s] = v
        return v

    def finalize(self):
        seen = set()
        for surf, cls in self.surface.items():
            sk = self.skel(surf)
            if not sk:
                continue
            root = self.find(cls)
            key = (surf, root)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            self.entries.append((surf, sk, root))
        # bucket by length for cheap pruning
        self.by_len = defaultdict(list)
        for surf, sk, root in self.entries:
            self.by_len[len(sk)].append((surf, sk, root))
        self.maxlen = max(self.by_len) if self.by_len else 0

    # --- lookup ---
    def resolve(self, token, band=0.22, maxcost=1.15):
        """Return list of (class, cost) candidates for a latin token."""
        key = token
        v = self._cache.get(key)
        if v is not None:
            return v
        surf = token
        direct = self.surface.get(surf)
        res = []
        if direct is not None:
            res = [(self.find(direct), 0.0)]
        else:
            sk = self.skel(surf)
            if not sk:
                self._cache[key] = []
                return []
            best = {}
            lo = len(sk)
            cut = min(maxcost, 0.34 * len(sk) + 0.22)
            span = int(cut / 0.40) + 1
            for L in range(max(1, lo - span), min(self.maxlen, lo + span) + 1):
                for surf2, sk2, root in self.by_len[L]:
                    d = pdist(sk, sk2, cut)
                    if d <= cut:
                        if root not in best or d < best[root]:
                            best[root] = d
            if best:
                bv = min(best.values())
                res = sorted([(r, d) for r, d in best.items()
                              if d <= bv + band], key=lambda x: x[1])
        self._cache[key] = res
        return res


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# name parsing into roles
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def split_tokens(name):
    toks, comma = tokenize(name)
    return toks, comma


def classify_tokens(tokens):
    """Return dicts describing each token."""
    info = []
    n = len(tokens)
    for idx, t in enumerate(tokens):
        lat = to_latin(t)
        bare = re.sub(r"[^a-z']", "", lat)
        sc = script_of(t)
        d = {"raw": t, "lat": lat, "bare": bare, "script": sc,
             "idx": idx, "kind": "core"}
        if is_initial(t.strip(".")):
            d["kind"] = "initial"
        elif bare in NASAB and idx + 1 < n:
            d["kind"] = "nasab_marker"
        elif sc == "arab" and ar_normalize(t) in ("بن",
                                                  "ابن"):
            d["kind"] = "nasab_marker"
        info.append(d)
    return info


def join_abd(tokens):
    """Join arabic 'abd (al) X' compounds and 'nasr allah'."""
    out = []
    i = 0
    n = len(tokens)
    while i < n:
        t = tokens[i]
        b = t[1]
        if b.startswith("abd") and len(b) <= 6 and i + 1 < n:
            nxt = tokens[i + 1][1]
            nxt_s = strip_article(nxt)
            out.append((t[0] + " " + tokens[i + 1][0], b + nxt_s))
            i += 2
            continue
        if b in ("nasr",) and i + 1 < n and tokens[i + 1][1] in (
                "allah", "alla", "ullah"):
            out.append((t[0] + " " + tokens[i + 1][0], "nasrallah"))
            i += 2
            continue
        out.append(t)
        i += 1
    return out


class NameParse(object):
    """Structured view of a personal name."""

    def __init__(self, name):
        self.name = name
        toks, comma = split_tokens(name)
        info = classify_tokens(toks)
        self.comma = comma
        core = []          # list of (raw, bare)
        strands = []
        nasab = []
        initials = []
        pend = []
        i = 0
        n = len(info)
        while i < n:
            d = info[i]
            if d["kind"] == "initial":
                initials.append(d["bare"])
                i += 1
                continue
            if d["kind"] == "nasab_marker":
                # following token is the father's name
                if i + 1 < n:
                    j = i + 1
                    nb = info[j]["bare"]
                    if info[j]["script"] == "arab":
                        nb = info[j]["raw"]
                    nasab.append(nb)
                    i = j + 1
                    continue
                i += 1
                continue
            b = d["bare"] if d["script"] == "latin" else d["raw"]
            if d["script"] == "latin":
                stripped = strip_article(b)
                if b in WEST_PARTICLES or b in ARTICLES:
                    if i + 1 < n and info[i + 1]["kind"] == "core":
                        pend.append(b)
                        i += 1
                        continue
                    strands.append(b)
                    i += 1
                    continue
                if stripped != b:
                    b = stripped
                if pend:
                    joined = "".join(p for p in pend if p not in ARTICLES or
                                     p in WEST_PARTICLES)
                    if joined and joined not in ("al", "el"):
                        b2 = joined + b
                    else:
                        b2 = b
                    core.append((d["raw"], b2, b))
                    pend = []
                    i += 1
                    continue
                core.append((d["raw"], b, b))
            else:
                core.append((d["raw"], b, b))
            i += 1
        strands.extend(pend)
        # join arabic compounds
        joined = []
        k = 0
        while k < len(core):
            raw, b, plain = core[k]
            if b.startswith("abd") and len(b) <= 6 and k + 1 < len(core):
                nxt = strip_article(core[k + 1][1])
                joined.append((raw + " " + core[k + 1][0], b + nxt,
                               b + nxt))
                k += 2
                continue
            if b == "nasr" and k + 1 < len(core) and core[k + 1][1] in (
                    "allah", "alla", "ullah", "ulla"):
                joined.append((raw, "nasrallah", "nasrallah"))
                k += 2
                continue
            joined.append((raw, b, plain))
            k += 1
        self.core = joined
        self.strands = strands
        self.nasab = nasab
        self.initials = initials

    def __repr__(self):
        return "NameParse(%r core=%r strands=%r nasab=%r)" % (
            self.name, [c[1] for c in self.core], self.strands, self.nasab)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# resolution of parsed names into class hypotheses
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def is_patronymic(bare, script):
    if script != "latin":
        lat = to_latin(bare)
    else:
        lat = bare
    return looks_patronymic(lat)


class Resolver(object):
    def __init__(self, lex):
        self.lex = lex

    def classes(self, tok):
        """Candidate classes for a core token (any script)."""
        sc = script_of(tok)
        if sc == "latin":
            base = tok
        else:
            direct = self.lex.surface.get(tok)
            if direct is None and sc == "arab":
                direct = self.lex.surface.get(ar_normalize(tok))
            if direct is not None:
                return [(self.lex.find(direct), 0.0)]
            base = to_latin(tok)
        out = self.lex.resolve(base)
        if not out:
            # unknown: token forms its own pseudo class
            return [("?" + "".join(self.lex.skel(base)), 0.0)]
        return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# watchlist entry model
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class EntryName(object):
    """A single name of an entry, resolved into classes."""

    __slots__ = ("given", "family", "nasab", "middles", "raw", "weak",
                 "tokens")

    def __init__(self, given, family, nasab, middles, raw, weak=False):
        self.given = given
        self.family = family
        self.nasab = nasab
        self.middles = middles
        self.raw = raw
        self.weak = weak


def parse_entry_person(name, resolver):
    """Parse a watchlist person name into (given, family, extras)."""
    p = NameParse(name)
    core = p.core
    if not core:
        return None
    cls = []
    for raw, bare, plain in core:
        sc = script_of(raw)
        if sc == "latin":
            key = bare
        else:
            key = bare
        cls.append((key, sc, bare))
    # patronymic detection on middles
    idxs = list(range(len(core)))
    if len(idxs) == 1:
        return EntryName(None, core[0][1], [], [], name)
    given = core[0][1]
    family = core[-1][1]
    middles = [c[1] for c in core[1:-1]]
    return EntryName(given, family, list(p.nasab), middles, name)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# date handling
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def norm_date(s):
    s = (s or "").strip()
    if not s:
        return ""
    s = s.replace("/", "-")
    m = re.match(r"^(\d{4})(?:-(\d{1,2}))?(?:-(\d{1,2}))?$", s)
    if not m:
        return ""
    y, mo, d = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)
    out = y
    if mo:
        out += "-%02d" % int(mo)
        if d:
            out += "-%02d" % int(d)
    return out


def dob_compare(cust, entry):
    """Return 'agree', 'conflict' or 'unknown'."""
    c, e = norm_date(cust), norm_date(entry)
    if not c or not e:
        return "unknown"
    n = min(len(c), len(e))
    if c[:n] == e[:n]:
        return "agree"
    return "conflict"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# engine
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Engine(object):
    def __init__(self, watchlist):
        self.entries = watchlist
        self.lex = Lexicon()
        self.res = Resolver(self.lex)
        self._build_lexicon()
        self._build_index()

    # -- lexicon -----------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_lexicon(self):
        lex = self.lex
        persons = [e for e in self.entries if e.get("type") == "individual"]
        parses = {}
        for e in persons:
            pn = e.get("primary_name") or ""
            pp = NameParse(pn)
            parses[e["uid"]] = pp
            for raw, bare, plain in pp.core:
                if script_of(raw) == "latin":
                    lex.add_surface(bare, bare)
            for nb in pp.nasab:
                if script_of(nb) == "latin":
                    b = strip_article(re.sub(r"[^a-z']", "", to_latin(nb)))
                    lex.add_surface(b, b)
        # script names: align with the latin primary
        for e in persons:
            sn = e.get("script_name")
            pn = e.get("primary_name") or ""
            if not sn or script_of(pn) != "latin":
                continue
            pp = parses[e["uid"]]
            sp = NameParse(sn)
            if len(sp.core) == len(pp.core) and len(sp.nasab) == len(pp.nasab):
                for (sraw, sbare, _), (praw, pbare, _) in zip(sp.core,
                                                              pp.core):
                    lex.add_surface(ar_normalize(sbare) if
                                    script_of(sbare) == "arab" else sbare,
                                    pbare)
                for sn2, pn2 in zip(sp.nasab, pp.nasab):
                    a = ar_normalize(sn2) if script_of(sn2) == "arab" else sn2
                    b = strip_article(re.sub(r"[^a-z']", "", to_latin(pn2)))
                    lex.add_surface(a, b)
        # strong aliases: align with primary
        for e in persons:
            pn = e.get("primary_name") or ""
            pp = parses[e["uid"]]
            for al in e.get("aliases") or []:
                if al.get("strength") != "strong":
                    continue
                ap = NameParse(al["name"])
                if len(ap.core) != len(pp.core):
                    continue
                ok = True
                for (araw, abare, _), (praw, pbare, _) in zip(ap.core,
                                                              pp.core):
                    if script_of(araw) != "latin":
                        ok = False
                if not ok:
                    continue
                for (araw, abare, _), (praw, pbare, _) in zip(ap.core,
                                                              pp.core):
                    if script_of(praw) == "latin":
                        lex.add_surface(abare, pbare)
                    else:
                        lex.add_surface(abare, pbare)
        # nickname table (only where the full form is known)
        lex.finalize0 = True
        for nick, full in nickname_pairs():
            if full in lex.surface:
                lex.add_surface(nick, lex.surface[full])
            elif nick in lex.surface:
                lex.add_surface(full, lex.surface[nick])
        # gender normalisation for slavic surnames
        for surf in list(lex.surface.keys()):
            if script_of(surf) != "latin":
                continue
            m = re.match(r"^(.*(?:ov|ev|in|yn))a$", surf)
            if m and m.group(1) in lex.surface:
                lex.union(lex.surface[surf], lex.surface[m.group(1)])
                continue
            if surf.endswith("skaya") and surf[:-5] + "sky" in lex.surface:
                lex.union(lex.surface[surf], lex.surface[surf[:-5] + "sky"])
            elif surf.endswith("aya") and surf[:-3] + "y" in lex.surface:
                lex.union(lex.surface[surf], lex.surface[surf[:-3] + "y"])
        lex.finalize()

    # -- index -------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_index(self):
        self.by_id = {}
        self.by_class = defaultdict(list)
        self.by_org = defaultdict(list)
        self.by_weak = defaultdict(list)
        self.persons = []
        self.orgs = []
        for e in self.entries:
            uid = e["uid"]
            for ident in e.get("ids") or []:
                key = (ident.get("type", "").strip().lower(),
                       re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "",
                              (ident.get("number") or "").lower()))
                self.by_id.setdefault(key, []).append(uid)
            typ = e.get("type")
            if typ == "individual":
                names = self._person_names(e)
                e["_names"] = names
                for nm in names:
                    for c in nm["family_cls"]:
                        self.by_class[c].append((e, nm))
                    for c in nm["given_cls"]:
                        self.by_class[c].append((e, nm))
                for al in e.get("aliases") or []:
                    if al.get("strength") == "weak":
                        self.by_weak[weak_key(al["name"])].append(e)
                self.persons.append(e)
            else:
                keys = self._org_keys(e)
                e["_orgkeys"] = keys
                for k in keys:
                    self.by_org[k].append(e)
                for al in e.get("aliases") or []:
                    if al.get("strength") == "weak":
                        self.by_weak[weak_key(al["name"])].append(e)
                self.orgs.append(e)

    def _person_names(self, e):
        out = []
        seen = set()
        cand = [(e.get("primary_name") or "", "primary")]
        if e.get("script_name") and e["script_name"] != e.get("primary_name"):
            cand.append((e["script_name"], "script"))
        for al in e.get("aliases") or []:
            if al.get("strength") == "strong":
                cand.append((al["name"], "alias"))
        for nm, kind in cand:
            if not nm.strip():
                continue
            p = NameParse(nm)
            if not p.core:
                continue
            core = [c[1] for c in p.core]
            # drop patronymics from the core for role assignment
            keep = []
            patro = []
            for c in core:
                if len(core) > 2 and is_patronymic(c, script_of(c)):
                    patro.append(c)
                else:
                    keep.append(c)
            if not keep:
                keep = core
            given = keep[0]
            family = keep[-1]
            gc = [c for c, _ in self.res.classes(given)]
            fc = [c for c, _ in self.res.classes(family)]
            if len(keep) == 1:
                gc = []
            mids = keep[1:-1]
            key = (tuple(gc), tuple(fc))
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            out.append({"raw": nm, "kind": kind, "given_cls": gc,
                        "family_cls": fc, "mids": mids,
                        "single": len(keep) == 1,
                        "nasab": p.nasab, "patro": patro})
        return out

    def _org_keys(self, e):
        keys = set()
        names = [e.get("primary_name") or ""]
        for al in e.get("aliases") or []:
            if al.get("strength") == "strong":
                names.append(al["name"])
        for nm in names:
            for k in org_keys(nm, e.get("type")):
                keys.add(k)
        return keys

    # -- matching ----------------------------------------------------------
    def screen(self, cust):
        typ = (cust.get("type") or "").strip().lower()
        idt = (cust.get("id_type") or "").strip().lower()
        idn = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", (cust.get("id_number") or "").lower())
        hits = []                      # (rank, uid, entry)
        if idt and idn:
            for uid in self.by_id.get((idt, idn), []):
                hits.append((0, uid))
        if hits:
            hits.sort(key=lambda h: (h[0], h[1]))
            return hits[0][1]
        name = cust.get("full_name") or ""
        dob = cust.get("dob") or ""
        cands = []
        if typ == "individual":
            cands = self.match_person(name, dob)
        elif typ in ("entity", "vessel"):
            cands = self.match_org(name, typ)
            if not cands:
                cands = self.match_person(name, dob)
        else:
            cands = self.match_org(name, typ) or self.match_person(name, dob)
        # weak aliases (need identical full dob)
        cands.extend(self.match_weak(name, dob))
        if not cands:
            return None
        # tie-break: identifier support, then dob support, then lowest uid
        best = sorted(cands, key=lambda c: (-c[0], c[1]))
        return best[0][1]

    def match_weak(self, name, dob):
        out = []
        if len(norm_date(dob)) != 10:
            return out
        k = weak_key(name)
        if not k:
            return out
        for e in self.by_weak.get(k, []):
            if norm_date(e.get("dob") or "") == norm_date(dob):
                out.append((1, e["uid"]))
        return out

    def match_person(self, name, dob):
        p = NameParse(name)
        core = [c[1] for c in p.core]
        if not core:
            return []
        # classify tokens
        cls = [self.res.classes(c) for c in core]
        patro_flags = [is_patronymic(c, script_of(c)) for c in core]
        # candidate entries share at least one class
        cand = {}
        for lst in cls:
            for c, _ in lst:
                for e, nm in self.by_class.get(c, ()):
                    cand.setdefault(e["uid"], (e, []))[1].append(nm)
        out = []
        for uid, (e, nms) in cand.items():
            st = dob_compare(dob, e.get("dob") or "")
            if st == "conflict":
                continue
            ok = False
            for nm in e["_names"]:
                if self.name_match(p, core, cls, patro_flags, nm):
                    ok = True
                    break
            if ok:
                out.append((2 if st == "agree" else 1, uid))
        return out

    def name_match(self, p, core, cls, patro_flags, nm):
        """Does the customer name correspond to this entry name?"""
        n = len(core)
        if nm["single"]:
            # entry has a one-token name: require the customer to be that name
            if n != 1:
                return False
            return any(c == nm["family_cls"][0] for c, _ in cls[0]) if \
                nm["family_cls"] else False
        if n == 1:
            return False
        gset = set(nm["given_cls"])
        fset = set(nm["family_cls"])
        if not gset or not fset:
            return False
        # index positions usable as given / family: the two ends of the core,
        # ignoring patronymics
        idx = [i for i in range(n) if not (patro_flags[i] and 0 < i)]
        if len(idx) < 2:
            idx = list(range(n))
        first, last = idx[0], idx[-1]
        cands_first = set(c for c, _ in cls[first])
        cands_last = set(c for c, _ in cls[last])
        # stranded particles may belong to the family name
        extra_first = self._strand_variants(p, core[first])
        extra_last = self._strand_variants(p, core[last])
        cands_first |= extra_first
        cands_last |= extra_last
        if (cands_first & gset) and (cands_last & fset):
            return True
        if (cands_last & gset) and (cands_first & fset):
            return True
        return False

    def _strand_variants(self, p, tok):
        out = set()
        if not p.strands:
            return out
        pref = "".join(p.strands)
        for v in (pref + tok, tok + pref):
            for c, _ in self.res.classes(v):
                out.add(c)
        if len(p.strands) > 1:
            v = p.strands[-1] + tok
            for c, _ in self.res.classes(v):
                out.add(c)
        return out

    def match_org(self, name, typ):
        keys = org_keys(name, typ)
        out = []
        seen = set()
        for k in keys:
            for e in self.by_org.get(k, ()):
                if e["uid"] in seen:
                    continue
                seen.add(e["uid"])
                out.append((1, e["uid"]))
        return out


def weak_key(name):
    s = deaccent(name)
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9 ]", " ", s)
    return " ".join(s.split())


def org_keys(name, typ):
    """Normalised keys for an organisation / vessel name."""
    s = deaccent(name)
    s = s.replace("&", " and ")
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", s)
    words = [w for w in s.split() if w]
    # strip vessel prefixes
    raw = deaccent(name)
    raw = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9/ ]+", " ", raw)
    rw = raw.split()
    while rw and rw[0] in VESSEL_PREFIXES:
        rw = rw[1:]
        words = [w for w in re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", " ".join(rw)).split()]
    out = []
    while words and words[0] in ("the",):
        words = words[1:]
    kept = []
    for w in words:
        if w in LEGAL_DROP_WORDS:
            continue
        kept.append(w)
    # drop trailing legal designators
    core = list(kept)
    while core and core[-1] in LEGAL_FORMS:
        core.pop()
    if not core:
        core = kept
    keys = set()
    keys.add(" ".join(core))
    # chinese stem variants on the first word
    if core:
        stems = CHINESE_ROM.get(core[0])
        if stems:
            for st in stems:
                keys.add(" ".join([st] + core[1:]))
    return keys

def run(watchlist_path, customers_path, out_path):
    with open(watchlist_path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        watchlist = json.load(fh)
    eng = Engine(watchlist)
    rows = []
    with open(customers_path, encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as fh:
        rd = csv.DictReader(fh)
        for cust in rd:
            uid = eng.screen(cust)
            rows.append((cust.get("customer_id", ""),
                         "MATCH" if uid else "NO_MATCH", uid or ""))
    with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
        wr = csv.writer(fh)
        wr.writerow(["customer_id", "decision", "matched_uid"])
        for r in rows:
            wr.writerow(r)
    return rows


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="sanctions screening")
    ap.add_argument("--watchlist", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--customers", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    run(args.watchlist, args.customers, args.out)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

import csv

from collections import defaultdict

import screen as S


def main():
    cust_path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else '/app/dev/customers_dev.csv'
    lab_path = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else '/app/dev/labels_dev.csv'
    show = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else ''
    t0 = time.time()
    W = json.load(open('/app/watchlist.json'))
    eng = S.Engine(W)
    t1 = time.time()
    customers = list(csv.DictReader(open(cust_path, encoding='utf-8-sig')))
    labels = {l['customer_id']: l for l in csv.DictReader(open(lab_path))}
    ent = {e['uid']: e for e in W}
    res = {}
    for c in customers:
        res[c['customer_id']] = eng.screen(c)
    t2 = time.time()

    stats = defaultdict(lambda: [0, 0, 0, 0])   # n, correct_dec, correct_uid, wrong
    errs = defaultdict(list)
    tp = fp = fn = uid_ok = 0
    for c in customers:
        cid = c['customer_id']
        lab = labels[cid]
        got = res[cid]
        exp = lab['expected_uid'] if lab['expected_decision'] == 'MATCH' else None
        cl = lab['class']
        st = stats[cl]
        st[0] += 1
        if exp and got:
            tp += 1
            if got == exp:
                uid_ok += 1
                st[1] += 1
            else:
                st[3] += 1
                errs['WRONGUID:' + cl].append((c, exp, got))
        elif exp and not got:
            fn += 1
            st[3] += 1
            errs['FN:' + cl].append((c, exp, got))
        elif not exp and got:
            fp += 1
            st[3] += 1
            errs['FP:' + cl].append((c, exp, got))
        else:
            st[1] += 1
    prec = tp / (tp + fp) if tp + fp else 1.0
    rec = tp / (tp + fn) if tp + fn else 1.0
    print('build %.1fs  screen %.1fs (%d customers)' % (t1 - t0, t2 - t1, len(customers)))
    print('TP %d  FP %d  FN %d  precision %.4f  recall %.4f  uid_acc %.4f'

    for cl in sorted(stats):

            flag = '  <== recall floor'
        if cl.startswith('D') and bad / n > 0.05:
            flag = '  <== fp floor'
        if cl.startswith('R') and bad / n > 0.01:
            flag = '  <== fp floor'
        print('%-30s %5d %6d %6.3f%s' % (cl, n, bad, bad / n, flag))
    print()
    for k in sorted(errs):
        if show and show not in k:
            continue
        print('=' * 10, k, len(errs[k]))
        for c, exp, got in errs[k][:int(sys.argv[4]) if len(sys.argv) > 4 else 6]:
            print('  CUST %-40r dob=%-10s id=%s:%s' % (c['full_name'], c['dob'], c['id_type'], c['id_number']))
            for uid, tag in ((exp, 'EXP'), (got, 'GOT')):
                if not uid:

                e = ent[uid]
                al = ' | '.join('%s(%s)' % (a['name'], a['strength'][0]) for a in e['aliases'])
                print('    %s %s %-35r script=%s dob=%s ids=%s al=[%s]' % (
                    tag, uid, e['primary_name'], e['script_name'], e['dob'], e['ids'], al))


main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Sanctions screening engine.

Decides, for every customer record, whether it refers to the same person,
company or vessel as a watchlist entry, under the rules of
``screening_policy.md``: transliteration equivalence for Arabic, Persian and
Cyrillic romanisations, Chinese romanisations of company stems, name order,
particles, patronymics, nicknames, strong/weak aliases, company suffixes,
vessel prefixes, identifiers and dates of birth.

Standard library only.  Usage::

    python3 screen.py --watchlist watchlist.json --customers customers.csv \
                      --out decisions.csv
"""

import argparse
import csv
import json
import re
import sys
import unicodedata
from collections import defaultdict

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. character level normalisation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Graphemes expanded before combining marks are stripped: dropping the mark
# would destroy the sound (Turkish "ş" is sh, Czech "č" is ch, ...).
PRE_MAP = {
    "ß": "ss", "æ": "ae", "œ": "oe", "ø": "o", "å": "a",
    "ü": "ue", "ö": "oe", "ä": "ae",
    "ı": "i", "ş": "sh", "ç": "ch", "ğ": "gh",
    "š": "sh", "ž": "zh", "č": "ch", "ć": "ch", "ś": "sh",
    "ź": "zh", "ż": "zh", "ř": "rzh", "ł": "l", "ń": "n",
    "ę": "e", "ą": "a", "ñ": "n", "ð": "d", "þ": "th", "đ": "d",
    "ș": "sh", "ț": "ts", "ĉ": "ch", "ĵ": "j", "ŝ": "sh", "ĝ": "j",
}


def deaccent(s):
    """Lower-case, expand special graphemes, drop combining marks."""
    s = s.lower()
    if any(c in PRE_MAP for c in s):
        s = "".join(PRE_MAP.get(c, c) for c in s)
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFD", s)
    return "".join(c for c in s if not unicodedata.combining(c))


ARABIC_RE = re.compile(r"[؀-ۿݐ-ݿﭐ-﷿ﹰ-﻿]")
CYRILLIC_RE = re.compile(r"[Ѐ-ӿԀ-ԯ]")
CJK_RE = re.compile(r"[㐀-鿿]")


def script_of(s):
    if ARABIC_RE.search(s):
        return "arab"
    if CYRILLIC_RE.search(s):
        return "cyr"
    if CJK_RE.search(s):
        return "cjk"
    return "latin"


# --- Arabic / Persian -------------------------------------------------------

AR_NORM = {
    "ي": "ی", "ى": "ی", "ئ": "ی",
    "ك": "ک", "ة": "ه",
    "أ": "ا", "إ": "ا", "آ": "ا",
    "ٱ": "ا", "ؤ": "و",
}

AR_TRANSLIT = {
    "ا": "a", "ب": "b", "ت": "t", "ث": "th",
    "ج": "j", "ح": "h", "خ": "kh", "د": "d",
    "ذ": "dh", "ر": "r", "ز": "z", "س": "s",
    "ش": "sh", "ص": "s", "ض": "d", "ط": "t",
    "ظ": "z", "ع": "", "غ": "gh", "ف": "f",
    "ق": "q", "ک": "k", "ل": "l", "م": "m",
    "ن": "n", "ه": "h", "و": "u", "ی": "i",
    "ء": "", "ـ": "", "پ": "p", "چ": "ch",
    "ژ": "zh", "گ": "g",
}

AR_ARTICLE = "ال"          # alef + lam
AR_ALLAH = "الله"
AR_ABD = "عبد"
AR_NASR = "نصر"
AR_BIN = ("بن", "ابن", "بنت")


def ar_normalize(s):
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", s)
    s = "".join(c for c in s if not ("ً" <= c <= "ْ"))

# --- Cyrillic ---------------------------------------------------------------

    "а": "a", "б": "b", "в": "v", "г": "g",
    "д": "d", "е": "e", "ё": "yo", "ж": "zh",
    "з": "z", "и": "i", "й": "y", "к": "k",
    "л": "l", "м": "m", "н": "n", "о": "o",
    "п": "p", "р": "r", "с": "s", "т": "t",
    "у": "u", "ф": "f", "х": "kh", "ц": "ts",
    "ч": "ch", "ш": "sh", "щ": "shch", "ъ": "",
    "ы": "y", "ь": "", "э": "e", "ю": "yu",
    "я": "ya", "є": "ye", "і": "i", "ї": "yi",
    "ґ": "g", "ў": "v",
}


def cyr_translit(s):
    return "".join(CYR_TRANSLIT.get(c, c) for c in s.lower())


def to_latin(tok):
    sc = script_of(tok)
    if sc == "cyr":
        return cyr_translit(tok)
    if sc == "arab":
        return ar_translit(tok)

# 2. phonetic skeleton
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#
# A skeleton is a tuple of coarse phoneme symbols.  Orthographic conventions
# that spell one sound differently (sch/sh/sz/sj/s-caron, tsch/tch/cz/ch,
# w/v, ff/v, kh/ch/h, ou/u, y/i, doubled letters, silent final -e/-h)
# collapse onto the same symbol; vowels collapse into three classes so that
# vowel colouring is cheap but vowel *position* is still significant
# (Faris != Farsi).

VOWELS = set("aeiouy")

    ("tsch", "C"), ("dsch", "J"), ("sch", "S"), ("tch", "C"),
    ("tsh", "C"), ("dzh", "J"), ("zsh", "Z"), ("sz", "S"),
    ("sh", "S"), ("cz", "C"), ("sj", "S"), ("tj", "C"),
    ("dj", "J"), ("zh", "Z"), ("ts", "T"), ("tz", "T"),
    ("ch", "X"), ("kh", "h"), ("gh", "g"), ("ph", "f"),
    ("th", "t"), ("ck", "k"), ("qu", "k v"), ("qv", "k v"),
    ("x", "k s"), ("q", "k"), ("w", "v"), ("rzh", "r"),

def skeleton(tok):
    """Phonetic skeleton of a latin token, as a tuple of symbols."""
    s = deaccent(tok)
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z]", "", s)
    if not s:
        return ()
    if len(s) > 3 and s.endswith("e") and s[-2] not in VOWELS:
        s = s[:-1]                      # silent final -e   (Bakre -> Bakr)
    if len(s) > 3 and s.endswith("h") and s[-2] in VOWELS:
        s = s[:-1]                      # final -h          (Hudah -> Huda)
    out = []
    i = 0
    n = len(s)
    while i < n:
        ch = s[i]
        if ch in VOWELS:
            if ch in "yi" and i + 1 < n and s[i + 1] in "aeou" and \
                    (i == 0 or s[i - 1] not in VOWELS):
                out.append("y")         # consonantal y / i  (Yusuf, Iachin)
                i += 1
                continue
            j = i
            while j < n and s[j] in VOWELS:
                j += 1
            if j - i > 1 and s[j - 1] in "yi" and j < n and s[j] in VOWELS:
                out.append(VOWEL_CLASS.get(s[i], "E"))
                out.append("y")         # Sayed, Nayef
                i = j
                continue
            out.append(VOWEL_CLASS.get(s[i], "E"))
            i = j
            continue
        hit = False
        for gr, rep in DIGRAPHS:
            if s.startswith(gr, i):
                out.extend(rep.split())
                i += len(gr)
                hit = True
                break
        if hit:
            continue
        if ch == "j":
            out.append("J")
        elif ch == "c":
            out.append("c")             # ambiguous bare c
        else:
            out.append(ch)
        i += 1
    res = []
    for sym in out:
        if res and res[-1] == sym:
            continue
        res.append(sym)
    return tuple(res)

    c = {}

    def put(a, b, v):

def pdist(a, b, cutoff=1.2):
    """Bounded weighted edit distance between two skeletons."""
    la, lb = len(a), len(b)
    if la == 0 or lb == 0:
        return sum(INDEL.get(x, DEFAULT_INDEL) for x in (a or b))
    prev2 = None
    prev = [0.0] * (lb + 1)
    for j in range(1, lb + 1):
        prev[j] = prev[j - 1] + INDEL.get(b[j - 1], DEFAULT_INDEL)
    for i in range(1, la + 1):
        ai = a[i - 1]
        cur = [prev[0] + INDEL.get(ai, DEFAULT_INDEL)] + [0.0] * lb
        best = cur[0]
        for j in range(1, lb + 1):
            bj = b[j - 1]
            if ai == bj:
                v = prev[j - 1]
            else:
                v = prev[j - 1] + SUB_COST.get((ai, bj), DEFAULT_SUB)
            d = prev[j] + INDEL.get(ai, DEFAULT_INDEL)

                b2 = strip_article(b)
                if pend:
                    west = [p for p in pend if p not in ARABIC_ARTICLES]
                    if west:
                        b2 = "".join(west) + b2
                    pend = []
                core.append((b2, "latin"))
            else:
                core.append((ar_strip_article(b) if sc == "arab" else b, sc))
            i += 1
        strands.extend(pend)
        self.core = core
        self.strands = strands
        self.nasab = nasab
        self.initials = initials
        self.ncore = len(core)

    def __repr__(self):
        return "NameParse(%r -> core=%r strand=%r nasab=%r)" % (
            self.name, self.core, self.strands, self.nasab)


def looks_patronymic(bare, sc):
    lat = bare if sc == "latin" else to_latin(bare)
    if len(lat) < 6:
        return False
    return bool(PATRONYM_RE.search(lat))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. lexicon: surface form -> canonical class
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Lexicon(object):
    def __init__(self):
        self.parent = {}
        self.surface = {}
        self.entries = []
        self.by_len = defaultdict(list)
        self.maxlen = 0
        self._cache = {}
        self._skel = {}

    def find(self, x):
        p = self.parent
        root = x
        while p.get(root, root) != root:
            root = p[root]
        while p.get(x, x) != x:
            p[x], x = root, p[x]
        return root

    def union(self, a, b):
        ra, rb = self.find(a), self.find(b)
        if ra == rb:
            return ra
        if rb < ra:
            ra, rb = rb, ra
        self.parent[rb] = ra
        return ra

    def add_surface(self, surf, cls):
        if not surf or not cls:
            return
        self.parent.setdefault(cls, cls)
        prev = self.surface.get(surf)
        if prev is None:
            self.surface[surf] = cls
        else:
            self.union(prev, cls)

    def skel(self, s):
        v = self._skel.get(s)
        if v is None:
            v = skeleton(s)
            self._skel[s] = v
        return v

    def finalize(self):
        seen = set()
        for surf, cls in self.surface.items():
            if script_of(surf) != "latin":
                continue
            sk = self.skel(surf)
            if not sk:
                continue
            root = self.find(cls)
            if (surf, root) in seen:
                continue
            seen.add((surf, root))
            self.entries.append((surf, sk, root))
        for surf, sk, root in self.entries:
            self.by_len[len(sk)].append((sk, root))
        self.maxlen = max(self.by_len) if self.by_len else 0

    def resolve(self, token, band=0.22):
        """Candidate (class, cost) list for a latin token."""
        hit = self._cache.get(token)
        if hit is not None:
            return hit
        res = []
        direct = self.surface.get(token)
        if direct is not None:
            res = [(self.find(direct), 0.0)]
        else:
            sk = self.skel(token)
            if sk:
                cut = min(1.15, 0.34 * len(sk) + 0.25)
                span = int(cut / 0.40) + 1
                best = {}
                lo, hi = max(1, len(sk) - span), min(self.maxlen,
                                                     len(sk) + span)
                for L in range(lo, hi + 1):
                    for sk2, root in self.by_len[L]:
                        d = pdist(sk, sk2, cut)
                        if d <= cut and (root not in best or d < best[root]):
                            best[root] = d
                if best:
                    bv = min(best.values())
                    res = sorted([(r, d) for r, d in best.items()
                                  if d <= bv + band], key=lambda x: x[1])
        self._cache[token] = res
        return res

def build_chinese_map():
    canon = set(r[0] for r in CHINESE_STEMS)
    m = defaultdict(set)
    for row in CHINESE_STEMS:
        head = row[0]
        m[head].add(head)
        for sp in row[1:]:
            sp = re.sub(r"\d", "", sp)
            if sp in canon and sp != head:
                continue          # never hijack another pinyin stem
            m[sp].add(head)
    return m


CHINESE_ROM = build_chinese_map()


def org_words(name):
    """Normalised content words of an organisation / vessel name."""
    s = deaccent(name)
    s = s.replace("&", " and ")
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", s)
    words = [w for w in s.split() if w]
    while words and words[0] in VESSEL_PREFIXES:
        words = words[1:]
    while words and words[0] in LEGAL_DROP_WORDS:
        words = words[1:]
    words = [w for w in words if w not in LEGAL_DROP_WORDS]
    core = list(words)
    while core and core[-1] in LEGAL_FORMS:
        core.pop()
    if not core:
        core = words
    return core


def org_key(name):
    return " ".join(org_words(name))


def org_variant_keys(name):
    """Keys after mapping a leading chinese stem to its pinyin form(s)."""
    core = org_words(name)
    out = set()
    if core:
        for st in CHINESE_ROM.get(core[0], ()):
            out.add(" ".join([st] + core[1:]))
    return out


def weak_key(name):
    s = deaccent(name)
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", s)
    return " ".join(s.split())

def norm_date(s):
    s = (s or "").strip()
    if not s:
        return ""
    s = s.replace("/", "-").replace(".", "-")
    m = re.match(r"^(\d{4})(?:-(\d{1,2}))?(?:-(\d{1,2}))?$", s)
    if not m:
        return ""
    out = m.group(1)
    if m.group(2):
        out += "-%02d" % int(m.group(2))
        if m.group(3):
            out += "-%02d" % int(m.group(3))
    return out


def dob_compare(cust, entry):
    c, e = norm_date(cust), norm_date(entry)
    if not c or not e:
        return "unknown"
    n = min(len(c), len(e))
    return "agree" if c[:n] == e[:n] else "conflict"

# 8. engine
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class Engine(object):
    def __init__(self, watchlist):
        self.entries = watchlist
        self.lex = Lexicon()
        self._parses = {}
        self._build_lexicon()
        self._build_index()

    # -- token resolution ---------------------------------------------------
    def classes(self, bare, sc="latin"):
        """Candidate classes for one core token."""
        if sc != "latin":
            direct = self.lex.surface.get(bare)
            if direct is not None:
                return [(self.lex.find(direct), 0.0)]
            lat = to_latin(bare)
            out = self.lex.resolve(lat)
            return out or [("?" + bare, 0.0)]
        out = self.lex.resolve(bare)
        if not out or out[0][1] > 0.0:
            alt = strip_article_attached(bare)
            if alt:
                o2 = self.lex.resolve(alt)
                if o2 and (not out or o2[0][1] < out[0][1]):
                    out = o2
        if not out:
            return [("?" + "".join(self.lex.skel(bare)), 0.0)]
        return out

    # -- lexicon ------------------------------------------------------------
    def parse(self, name):
        p = self._parses.get(name)
        if p is None:
            p = NameParse(name)
            self._parses[name] = p
        return p

    def _build_lexicon(self):
        lex = self.lex
        persons = [e for e in self.entries
                   if (e.get("type") or "").lower() == "individual"]
        for e in persons:
            pp = self.parse(e.get("primary_name") or "")
            for bare, sc in pp.core:
                if sc == "latin":
                    lex.add_surface(bare, bare)
            for bare, sc in pp.nasab:
                if sc == "latin":
                    lex.add_surface(bare, bare)
        # script names aligned with a latin primary
        for e in persons:
            sn = e.get("script_name")
            pn = e.get("primary_name") or ""
            if not sn or script_of(pn) != "latin":
                continue
            pp, sp = self.parse(pn), self.parse(sn)
            if len(sp.core) == len(pp.core) and len(sp.nasab) == len(pp.nasab):
                for (sb, ssc), (pb, psc) in zip(sp.core, pp.core):
                    if ssc != "latin" and psc == "latin":
                        lex.add_surface(sb, pb)
                for (sb, ssc), (pb, psc) in zip(sp.nasab, pp.nasab):
                    if ssc != "latin" and psc == "latin":
                        lex.add_surface(sb, pb)
        # strong aliases aligned with the primary
        for e in persons:
            pn = e.get("primary_name") or ""
            pp = self.parse(pn)
            for al in e.get("aliases") or []:
                if al.get("strength") != "strong":
                    continue
                ap = self.parse(al.get("name") or "")
                if len(ap.core) != len(pp.core):
                    continue
                for (ab, asc), (pb, psc) in zip(ap.core, pp.core):
                    if asc == "latin" and psc == "latin":
                        lex.add_surface(ab, pb)
                    elif asc == "latin" and psc != "latin":
                        cls = lex.surface.get(pb)
                        if cls:
                            lex.add_surface(ab, cls)
                for (ab, asc), (pb, psc) in zip(ap.nasab, pp.nasab):
                    if asc == "latin" and psc == "latin":
                        lex.add_surface(ab, pb)
        # english nicknames
        for full, nicks in NICKNAMES.items():
            cls = lex.surface.get(full)
            if cls is None:
                for nk in nicks:
                    if nk in lex.surface:
                        cls = lex.surface[nk]
                        break
            if cls is None:
                continue
            lex.add_surface(full, cls)
            for nk in nicks:
                lex.add_surface(nk, cls)
        # slavic feminine surnames
        for surf in list(lex.surface.keys()):
            if script_of(surf) != "latin":
                continue
            m = re.match(r"^(.*(?:ov|ev|in|yn))a$", surf)
            if m and m.group(1) in lex.surface:
                lex.union(lex.surface[surf], lex.surface[m.group(1)])
            elif surf.endswith("skaya") and surf[:-5] + "sky" in lex.surface:
                lex.union(lex.surface[surf], lex.surface[surf[:-5] + "sky"])
            elif surf.endswith("aya") and surf[:-3] + "y" in lex.surface:
                lex.union(lex.surface[surf], lex.surface[surf[:-3] + "y"])
        lex.finalize()

    # -- index --------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_index(self):
        self.by_id = defaultdict(list)
        self.by_class = defaultdict(list)
        self.by_org = defaultdict(list)
        self.by_orgvar = defaultdict(list)
        self.by_weak = defaultdict(list)
        for e in self.entries:
            for ident in e.get("ids") or []:
                key = ((ident.get("type") or "").strip().lower(),
                       re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "",
                              (ident.get("number") or "").lower()))
                self.by_id[key].append(e["uid"])
            for al in e.get("aliases") or []:
                if al.get("strength") == "weak":
                    self.by_weak[weak_key(al.get("name") or "")].append(e)
            typ = (e.get("type") or "").lower()
            if typ == "individual":
                names = self._person_names(e)
                e["_names"] = names
                seen = set()
                for nm in names:
                    for c in nm["given_cls"] + nm["family_cls"]:
                        if (c, id(nm)) in seen:
                            continue
                        seen.add((c, id(nm)))
                        self.by_class[c].append(e)
            else:
                keys, vkeys = set(), set()
                for nm in self._org_names(e):
                    keys.add(org_key(nm))
                    vkeys |= org_variant_keys(nm)
                e["_orgkeys"] = keys
                for k in keys:
                    self.by_org[k].append(e)
                for k in vkeys:
                    self.by_orgvar[k].append(e)

    def _org_names(self, e):
        out = [e.get("primary_name") or ""]
        for al in e.get("aliases") or []:
            if al.get("strength") == "strong":
                out.append(al.get("name") or "")
        return [n for n in out if n.strip()]

    def _person_names(self, e):
        out = []
        seen = set()
        cand = [e.get("primary_name") or ""]
        sn = e.get("script_name")
        if sn and sn != e.get("primary_name"):
            cand.append(sn)
        for al in e.get("aliases") or []:
            if al.get("strength") == "strong":
                cand.append(al.get("name") or "")
        for nm in cand:
            if not nm.strip():
                continue
            p = self.parse(nm)
            if not p.core:
                continue
            keep = [c for c in p.core
                    if not (len(p.core) > 2 and looks_patronymic(c[0], c[1]))]
            if len(keep) < 2:
                keep = list(p.core)
            gcls = [c for c, _ in self.classes(*keep[0])]
            fcls = [c for c, _ in self.classes(*keep[-1])]
            single = len(keep) == 1
            key = (tuple(sorted(gcls)), tuple(sorted(fcls)), single)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            out.append({"raw": nm, "given_cls": gcls, "family_cls": fcls,
                        "single": single})
        return out

    # -- screening ----------------------------------------------------------
    def screen(self, cust):
        typ = (cust.get("type") or "").strip().lower()
        idt = (cust.get("id_type") or "").strip().lower()
        idn = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", (cust.get("id_number") or "").lower())
        if idt and idn:
            uids = self.by_id.get((idt, idn))
            if uids:
                return sorted(uids)[0]
        name = cust.get("full_name") or ""
        dob = cust.get("dob") or ""
        if typ in ("entity", "vessel"):
            cands = self.match_org(name)
        elif typ == "individual":
            cands = self.match_person(name, dob)
        else:
            cands = self.match_org(name) or self.match_person(name, dob)
        cands = cands + self.match_weak(name, dob)
        if not cands:
            return None
        cands.sort(key=lambda c: (-c[0], c[1]))
        return cands[0][1]

    def match_weak(self, name, dob):
        out = []
        nd = norm_date(dob)
        if len(nd) != 10:
            return out
        for e in self.by_weak.get(weak_key(name), ()):
            if norm_date(e.get("dob") or "") == nd:
                out.append((2, e["uid"]))
        return out

    def match_org(self, name):
        out = []
        seen = set()
        for e in self.by_org.get(org_key(name), ()):
            if e["uid"] not in seen:
                seen.add(e["uid"])
                out.append((1, e["uid"]))
        if out:
            return out
        for k in org_variant_keys(name):
            for e in self.by_orgvar.get(k, ()):
                if e["uid"] not in seen:
                    seen.add(e["uid"])
                    out.append((1, e["uid"]))
        return out

    def match_person(self, name, dob):
        p = self.parse(name)
        if not p.core:
            return []
        cls = [self.classes(b, sc) for b, sc in p.core]
        patro = [looks_patronymic(b, sc) for b, sc in p.core]
        cand = {}
        for lst in cls:
            for c, _ in lst:
                for e in self.by_class.get(c, ()):
                    cand[e["uid"]] = e
        out = []
        for uid, e in cand.items():
            st = dob_compare(dob, e.get("dob") or "")
            if st == "conflict":
                continue
            for nm in e["_names"]:
                if self.name_match(p, cls, patro, nm):
                    out.append((2 if st == "agree" else 1, uid))
                    break
        return out

    def name_match(self, p, cls, patro, nm):
        n = len(cls)
        if nm["single"]:
            if n != 1 or not nm["family_cls"]:
                return False
            fset = set(nm["family_cls"])
            return bool(set(c for c, _ in cls[0]) & fset)
        if n < 2:
            return False
        gset, fset = set(nm["given_cls"]), set(nm["family_cls"])
        if not gset or not fset:
            return False
        idx = [i for i in range(n) if not (patro[i] and i > 0)]
        if len(idx) < 2:
            idx = list(range(n))
        first, last = idx[0], idx[-1]
        cf = set(c for c, _ in cls[first])
        cl = set(c for c, _ in cls[last])
        if (cf & gset) and (cl & fset):
            return True
        if (cl & gset) and (cf & fset):
            return True
        if p.strands:
            ef = cf | self._strand_classes(p, p.core[first])
            el = cl | self._strand_classes(p, p.core[last])
            if (ef & gset) and (el & fset):
                return True
            if (el & gset) and (ef & fset):
                return True
        return False

    def _strand_classes(self, p, core_tok):
        bare, sc = core_tok
        if sc != "latin":
            return set()
        out = set()
        for pref in ("".join(p.strands), p.strands[-1]):
            if not pref:
                continue
            for c, _ in self.classes(pref + bare):
                out.add(c)
        return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. driver
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def run(watchlist_path, customers_path, out_path):
    with open(watchlist_path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        watchlist = json.load(fh)
    eng = Engine(watchlist)
    rows = []
    with open(customers_path, encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as fh:
        for cust in csv.DictReader(fh):
            uid = eng.screen(cust)
            rows.append((cust.get("customer_id", ""),
                         "MATCH" if uid else "NO_MATCH", uid or ""))
    with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
        wr = csv.writer(fh)
        wr.writerow(["customer_id", "decision", "matched_uid"])
        wr.writerows(rows)
    return rows


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="sanctions screening")
    ap.add_argument("--watchlist", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--customers", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    run(args.watchlist, args.customers, args.out)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
